defects.what: The player-facing title is the generated build stamp: 'Lantern Rooftops 2026-10-231322', so the hero line reads as a debug artifact.
defects.fix: Display only 'Lantern Rooftops' on the menu and keep the timestamp out of any player-facing text; verify a fresh boot shows the clean title with no digits.

defects.what: Owls are near-invisible: a dark navy body with only two red eyes on the navy sky, so the swooping threat the brief calls 'clearly silhouetted' reads as a smudge.
defects.fix: Give owls a pale buff belly, a darker outline and a faint moonlit halo, and check at 1280x720 that an owl is identifiable in one glance in normal play.

defects.what: The goal chimney always shows its bright blue light beam while the HUD says 'The chimney is shut' and 0/10 lanterns are lit, so the locked/unlocked gate has no readable world-side state.
defects.fix: Drive the beam, cap and window glow from chimney_open: dark lidded cap while shut, beam only when open; verify shut at 0/10 and lit after the last lantern.

defects.what: The 'You fell into the street - 2 lives left' banner stays over the play area and fades for roughly four seconds after respawn, covering the walking lanes.
defects.fix: Cut the death banner to about 1.2s and place it above the instruction bar; verify it is gone before the player can reach the next lantern.

defects.what: Walkable rooftop surfaces and the street/void below sit in almost the same dark blue value, separated only by a thin pale rim, so footing is slow to read.
defects.fix: Raise the roof-top surface one value step or add a warm lantern rim along walkable edges; verify roof versus void is distinguishable at a glance.

doNotRegress.what: Lanterns light with a warm halo on approach and update the HUD count and score.
Jumping shows a clear airborne pose, an arc, and a live Jumps counter.
Falling respawns the player, removes a heart, keeps lit lanterns lit, and explains the loss on screen.
Menu works with both mouse click on Play and the Enter key.
HUD keeps lantern count, hearts, Jumps/Owls, chimney status, level name and timer visible.
Warm lantern glow against deep blue night with readable star field.
Camera scrolls smoothly with the player and parallax keeps the row readable.
Level name and control hints appear and fade without blocking play.

boots.note: Title/menu paints fully, console reports 0 errors, and three fresh headless boots all reached gameplay.

respondsToInput.note: Enter starts the level (63.19% pixel change), and d+Shift+Space lifts the player (y 320 to 281), switches the sprite to an airborne pose, increments Jumps 0 to 1 and lights a lantern. A click at (640,396) also started the level, so f1/f2's 0% is a click on empty menu space, not dead input.

coreActionVisible.note: Running, jumping, and automatic proximity lantern-lighting with a warm halo and HUD/score updates are all visible; falling gives a respawn with a life lost.

stateReadable.note: Top-left HUD shows lanterns lit x/10, three hearts, Jumps/Owls, and 'The chimney is shut'; top-right shows level and timer. After a fall the hearts drop to 2 and a banner states lives left.
